mapper.select: SELECT sla_policy_id, policy_code, policy_name, first_response_seconds, resolution_seconds, first_response_reminder_before_seconds, resolution_reminder_before_seconds, status, lock_version FROM sla_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sla_policy_id = #{slaPolicyId}

SELECT sla_policy_id, policy_code, policy_name, first_response_seconds, resolution_seconds, first_response_reminder_before_seconds, resolution_reminder_before_seconds, status, lock_version FROM sla_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sla_policy_id = #{slaPolicyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT sla_policy_id,policy_code,policy_name,first_response_seconds,resolution_seconds,first_response_reminder_before_seconds,resolution_reminder_before_seconds,status,lock_version FROM sla_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status=#{status} AND (policy_codepolicy_name > < #{cursorValue} OR (policy_codepolicy_name=#{cursorValue} AND sla_policy_id > < #{cursorId})) ORDER BY policy_codepolicy_name ASC DESC,sla_policy_id ASC DESC LIMIT #{queryLimit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_clock (tenant_id, sla_clock_id, ticket_id, sla_policy_id, clock_type, status, started_at, deadline_at, reminder_due_at, policy_duration_seconds, policy_reminder_before_seconds, milestone_at, breached_at, satisfied_at, lock_version, created_at, created_by_type, created_by_id, updated_at, updated_by_type, updated_by_id, cycle_no) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{slaClockId}, #{ticketId}, #{slaPolicyId}, #{clockType}, 'RUNNING', #{startedAt}, #{deadlineAt}, #{reminderDueAt}, #{durationSeconds}, #{reminderBeforeSeconds}, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, #{now}, 'SERVICE', NULL, #{now2}, 'SERVICE', NULL, #{cycleNo})
mapper.select: SELECT sla_clock_id, ticket_id, sla_policy_id, clock_type, status, cycle_no, started_at, deadline_at, reminder_due_at, policy_duration_seconds, policy_reminder_before_seconds, milestone_at, breached_at, satisfied_at, lock_version FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND clock_type = #{clockType} ORDER BY cycle_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sla_clock_id, ticket_id, sla_policy_id, clock_type, status, cycle_no, started_at, deadline_at, reminder_due_at, policy_duration_seconds, policy_reminder_before_seconds, milestone_at, breached_at, satisfied_at, lock_version FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND clock_type = #{clockType} ORDER BY cycle_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT sla_clock_id, ticket_id, sla_policy_id, clock_type, status, cycle_no, started_at, deadline_at, reminder_due_at, policy_duration_seconds, policy_reminder_before_seconds, milestone_at, breached_at, satisfied_at, lock_version FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sla_clock_id = #{slaClockId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT sla_clock_id, ticket_id, sla_policy_id, clock_type, status, cycle_no, started_at, deadline_at, reminder_due_at, policy_duration_seconds, policy_reminder_before_seconds, milestone_at, breached_at, satisfied_at, lock_version FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sla_clock_id = #{slaClockId}

SELECT sla_clock_id,ticket_id,status,clock_type,deadline_at,reminder_due_at,updated_at FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='RUNNING' AND ((reminder_due_at IS NOT NULL AND reminder_due_at <= #{now}) OR deadline_at <= #{now}) AND (updated_at > #{cursorUpdatedAt} OR (updated_at=#{cursorUpdatedAt} AND sla_clock_id > #{cursorClockId})) ORDER BY updated_at,sla_clock_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sla_clock_id,ticket_id,status,clock_type,deadline_at,reminder_due_at,updated_at FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='RUNNING' AND (updated_at > #{cursorUpdatedAt} OR (updated_at=#{cursorUpdatedAt} AND sla_clock_id > #{cursorClockId})) ORDER BY updated_at,sla_clock_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT updated_at, sla_clock_id FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, sla_clock_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sla_clock_id,ticket_id,status,clock_type,deadline_at,reminder_due_at,updated_at FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (updated_at > #{updatedAt} OR (updated_at=#{updatedAt} AND sla_clock_id > #{clockId})) ORDER BY updated_at,sla_clock_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id > #{afterTenantId} ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sla_clock_id, ticket_id, sla_policy_id, clock_type, status, cycle_no, started_at, deadline_at, reminder_due_at, policy_duration_seconds, policy_reminder_before_seconds, milestone_at, breached_at, satisfied_at, lock_version FROM sla_clock WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY cycle_no DESC, clock_type, sla_clock_id
SELECT sla_clock_id,stage,due_at,triggered_at FROM sla_trigger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sla_clock_id IN #{id} ORDER BY due_at,sla_clock_id

SELECT t.sla_trigger_id,t.sla_clock_id,c.ticket_id,t.stage FROM sla_trigger t JOIN sla_clock c ON c.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND c.sla_clock_id=t.sla_clock_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sla_trigger_recipient r WHERE r.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND r.sla_trigger_id=t.sla_trigger_id) AND t.sla_trigger_id > #{afterTriggerId} ORDER BY t.sla_trigger_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT sla_clock_id, stage, effect_key, due_at, triggered_at, publication_key FROM sla_trigger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sla_clock_id = #{slaClockId} AND stage = #{stage} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_trigger (tenant_id, sla_trigger_id, sla_clock_id, stage, effect_key, due_at, triggered_at, publication_key, created_at, created_by_type, created_by_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{triggerId}, #{slaClockId}, #{stage}, #{effectKey}, #{dueAt}, #{triggeredAt}, #{publicationKey}, #{triggeredAt2}, 'SCHEDULER', NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT recipient_user_id FROM sla_trigger_recipient WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sla_trigger_id=#{triggerId} ORDER BY recipient_user_id
